text:
sara: quick alert — found a partner PR that pasted a KMS-wrapped Vault blob (likely secret/partner/api_key). linking privately to sec channel.

devin: link received. do we know which key/version? staging or prod?

sara: header shows projects/our-proj/locations/global/keyRings/partner-kr/cryptoKeys/wrap-key/cryptoKeyVersions/12. PR notes mention staging but could be copied. I ran a quick iam check: partner-int-sa@partner.org has Decrypt permission from a 2024 grant.

sec-bot: INC-2026-198 created: "Partner PR — KMS-wrapped Vault blob exposure". Assigned to @sara.

rahul: immediate steps: 1) apply temporary deny for partner SA on the cryptoKey, 2) snapshot KMS and Vault audit logs to the forensics dataset, 3) enumerate Vault paths referencing that key.

devin: I'll own the KMS side. Prefer server-side rewrap if supported. If not, do decrypt+encrypt inside an ephemeral hardened VM in our secure project. No plaintext on disk, disable serial/output logging.

sara: I'll do the Vault enumeration: `vault kv list secret/partner || true` and fetch metadata only (`vault read -format=json secret/partner/api_key`) — do not attempt decryption here.

rahul: rotate any Vault consumer tokens that have read access to secret/partner. Also create alert: any Decrypt calls for wrap-key by principals outside our org -> page eng-security.

devin: plan: create new key version (v13), test rewrap on a copied ciphertext in a secure test project, push rotated ciphertexts back to Vault with `meta.rotated_by=eng-security` and timestamp. Keep old version active for 10 minutes post-rotation, then revoke.

sara: looping legal and partnerships for notification. partner informed via secure channel; told them we'll revoke access temporarily for investigation.

rahul: I will record the chain of custody steps and store the snapshots in the investigation bucket with restricted ACL. Update thread when deny is applied and when rewrap completes. :white_check_mark:
